description: This file defines the DirectoryEntry class used in the Android HoneycombGallery project. It encapsulates directory entries with methods to retrieve their name, drawable resource, and bitmap representation.

classes.name: DirectoryEntry
classes.description: Represents a directory entry with a name and associated resource ID, providing methods to retrieve its drawable and bitmap representations.

methods.name: DirectoryEntry
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DirectoryEntry with a name and resource ID.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the directory entry.

methods.name: getDrawable
methods.description: Returns a Drawable object for the resource ID using the provided Resources.

methods.name: getBitmap
methods.description: Returns a Bitmap object decoded from the resource ID using BitmapFactory.
